title: Account Manager
description:
Cybersecurity is one of the fastest-growing markets of our time – and at Orange Cyberdefense, we are growing with it. We are now looking for an Account Manager for Region East (Stockholm) who is not satisfied with being good – you want to be the best. You measure yourself against yourself, you hate losing, and you get back up faster than you fall.

About the role

As an Account Manager in Region East, you own your pipeline, which you build from the ground up. You drive the entire sales process – from identifying and engaging new prospects to developing and deepening existing customer relationships.

You will work for a company with some of Sweden’s strongest brands across both the private and public sectors. Your role is to understand the challenges these customers face and match them with the right cybersecurity solutions.

This is a complex business environment with high stakes and customers who expect a high-level advisory partner. It requires you to be knowledgeable, persistent, and able to maintain momentum – regardless of how long the sales cycle is.

You report to the Sales Manager and work closely with our technical specialists, presales resources, and consulting delivery teams. But your pipeline? That’s your responsibility.

Your main responsibilities

🎯 Own and drive your pipeline – from initial prospecting to signed agreement and beyond

🔥 Proactive outreach – you don’t wait for inbound leads; you create your own opportunities

🤝 Build long-term customer relationships – you are the customer’s primary contact and strategic partner

🔍 Identify and explore customer needs – and match them with the right cybersecurity solutions

📋 Lead negotiations – proposals, tenders, and contracts with precision and commercial acumen

🤜 Collaborate with specialists and consulting delivery – to ensure you deliver on your promises

🏗️ Build relationships with strategic vendors – and leverage them to strengthen your business opportunities

Who are you?

You are competitive – but you understand that the best business relationships are built on trust, not pressure. You combine relentless drive with the ability to listen, understand, and create genuine value for your customers.

You have a high personal pace and thrive when juggling multiple priorities at the same time. You are self-driven, structured, and always know exactly where you stand against your targets. You don’t need someone to remind you to follow up. You’ve already done it.

You are someone who never gives up on a deal – not because you are stubborn, but because you genuinely believe in the value you deliver and are willing to work to prove it. You see a “no” as an opportunity to understand more, not as a dead end.

You thrive in an environment where things move quickly, change is the norm, and you are expected to take initiative every day. You are down-to-earth and have no need for prestige – but you have an inner drive that never switches off.

This is a must:

✅ Demonstrably high personal drive – you have the numbers and results to prove it

✅ Experience in B2B sales, preferably within service sales involving complex deals

✅ A winning mindset – you measure yourself against your targets and deliver results

✅ The ability to independently manage your pipeline from prospect to closed deal

✅ Strong communication skills – you listen just as well as you act

✅ Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written

✅ Comfortable working at a fast pace and seeing challenges as fuel rather than obstacles

This is a plus:

⭐ Experience from the IT or cybersecurity industry

⭐ Experience in solution selling with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers

⭐ Experience selling to the public sector (LOU/tender processes)

About Orange Cyberdefense

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company, with 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,500 globally. Our vision is simple but powerful: We build a safer digital society.

We offer everything from in-depth technical solutions to strategic advisory services within governance, risk models, and security management.

We are all different – but share the same passion for cybersecurity. That is our strength. We ensure that all applications are handled equally and welcome applicants regardless of background and experience.

What we offer

🔐 The opportunity to work with some of the industry’s most dedicated experts and market-leading solutions

🚀 A rapidly growing market – with all the opportunities this brings for your career and earning potential

🤝 A down-to-earth team that wants you to succeed – and will help you get there

🌱 A Challenger culture that encourages curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement

🎯 A flexible working environment and genuine authority to influence how we work

Additional information

We recruit continuously and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person.

Orange Cyberdefense – Together, we build a safer digital society.

title: Bachelor and master’s thesis degree project
description:
Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. We are seeking students for multiple research projects in a wide range of topics. Both Bachelor and Master-level students are welcome to apply. You are welcome to conduct your project either alone or in pairs or groups of students. Our three main areas of interest are:

· Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics

· Management, organization, and ethics

· Artificial intelligence

We have identified some initial research suggestions within these areas. However, we leave it up to the students themselves to choose and propose the specific research question to explore within these areas.

Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics

Cybersecurity and information security sits at the core of our business. As such, these topics are particularly salient for us at Orange Cyberdefense – and we are eager to enable research in this field. Some of our initial research suggestions include:

· Analyze the relationship between different regulatory frameworks in relation to a security issue. For example, how current EU legislation affects third-party risk management.

· How employee awareness and security training influence susceptibility to phishing and social-engineering attacks.

· Cybersecurity risk in cloud environments. For example, examine common security risks associated with cloud services and how organizations can mitigate them.

Management, organization, and ethics

Orange Cyberdefense is an international company with 400 employees in Sweden and 3000 colleagues across the globe. As such, we are happy to enable research on management and organizational topics. A global research angle is also possible here. Research suggestions include:

· Studying organizational cultures, strategies, and characteristics of different Orange Cyberdefense business units in different countries. Possibly in terms of AI usage.

· Comparing our management strategies with those of other cybersecurity companies.

· Customer excellence research project which analyses customer needs in relation to the services provided by Orange Cyberdefense.

· Analysis of relevant regulatory, financial, organizational, technical and logistical characteristics which face different customers in different sectors.

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence is a key area of interest for us. We are very eager to proceed with a wide range of research projects on this topic. Some of our initial suggestions include:

· AI in phishing detection. Such as how phishing detection using linguistic and behavioral features compare to traditional classifiers.

· How attackers can manipulate inputs to evade AI-based intrusion detection systems.

· How large language models can identify and explain vulnerabilities.

Applying for a research project

Please apply by the ad. If you have more than one research idea, please include them all in one application. Make sure that your application reflects the following requirements:

· Include a short description of your proposed research, your area of interest, and clear suggestions for specific research question(s). It should be clear what you are interested in researching.

· Include initial suggestions for data collection- and analysis methods. Most importantly, describe what kind of data your project might need and from where you expect to collect it.

· Includes the full names of the participating student(s), what university you study at, if you are a bachelor or master’s student, and the approximate date your university expects you to start writing the thesis.

· The proposal does not exceed 1 page (or roughly 500 words) in length. If you want to propose more than one research idea, you may exceed this limit. However, please keep the length reasonably short.

What if I want to propose an entirely new research idea?

You do not have to base your research proposal on our existing research suggestions. We are very happy to receive your very own research idea. If you want to put forward your own project proposal, please follow the steps listed above.

Requirements and information about the research opportunity

Your profile and the specific skills required will vary greatly depending on the nature of your research project. However, all candidates must live up to the following requirements.

· You are a bachelor or master’s student enrolled in a program at a Swedish University.

· You are fluent in English and Swedish.

· You are capable and willing to take the initiative and drive your research project forward.

Students are assigned to a research mentor at Orange Cyberdefense. Your mentor will help you define your research project, check in with you at regular intervals, and act as your go-between for reaching resources and employees within Orange Cyberdefense. Please note that students will not be able to conduct research projects that involve data from our clients. Due to the sensitive nature of Orange Cyberdefenses business, students will not be able to fully carry out their projects on-premise. At the onset of your research project, you and other students writing their thesis at Orange Cyberdefense are invited to our office for a kickoff meeting.

Rights and ownership over research results will belong to Orange Cyberdefense. As such, students are expected to sign a research project agreement before starting their project. Orange Cyberdefense does not provide monetary compensation for student research projects. However, we view these research projects as an organic way to get to know candidates for future roles.

We are Orange Cyberdefense

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to help secure the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from advanced technical solutions to strategic services such as security governance, risk management frameworks, and risk assessments. We are 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,000 colleagues globally.

title: Financial Controller
additional_locations: Utrecht, Netherlands
description:
Wat je doet als Financial Controller
Ben jij iemand die zorgt voor een betrouwbare, volledige en tijdige financiële administratie? En neem jij graag het voortouw in het versterken van financiële processen, internal controls en rapportages?

Als Financial Controller ben je verantwoordelijk voor de integriteit, nauwkeurigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële rapportages en ondersteun je de organisatie door middel van scherpe analyses en heldere inzichten. Je bewaakt onze financiële positie, zorgt voor compliance met relevante wet- en regelgeving en draagt actief bij aan het optimaliseren van finance‑processen binnen Orange Cyberdefense.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s binnen Finance, andere afdelingen, de Orange Cyberdefense groep en externe partijen zoals accountants, klanten en leveranciers.

Als Financial Controller heb je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden:

- Voorbereiden en opstellen van financiële statements, rapportages en forecasts.

- Zorgdragen voor naleving van relevante wet- en regelgeving, boekhoudprincipes en interne policies.

- Uitvoeren en begeleiden van budgettering, monitoring en variantieanalyses.

- Coördineren van externe audits en contact onderhouden met auditors.

- Uitvoeren van financiële analyses om trends, risico’s en kansen te identificeren.

- Inrichten, onderhouden en verbeteren van interne controles en processen.

- Bewaken van cashflow, financiële risico’s en liquiditeitsplanning.

- Optimaliseren van ons ERP-systeem (AFAS) en faciliteren van rapportages.

- Opstellen van managementrapportages en uitvoeren van reportingrichting Orange Cyberdefense groep.

- Verantwoordelijk voor intercompany verrekeningen.

Werken bij Orange Cyberdefense
Orange Cyberdefense is de cybersecurity business unit van de Orange Groep en een internationale speler in het security domein. Wereldwijd werken ruim 3.200 specialisten aan het beschermen van organisaties in meer dan 160 landen.

In Nederland opereren we met zo’n 160 collega’s als een hecht, lokaal team. We combineren de slagkracht van een wereldwijde organisatie met de wendbaarheid en persoonlijke cultuur van een Nederlandse scale‑up.

Onze focus ligt op het bieden van hoogwaardige, betrouwbare en toekomstgerichte cybersecurity‑oplossingen aan organisaties in Nederland — met de kennis en innovatiekracht van een internationale marktleider. ‘We think global, act local’.

We hebben als organisatie en zeker als Finance flinke professionaliseringsstappen gemaakt, maar er is nog genoeg te verbeteren. Dat houdt in dat we verwachten dat je ondernemend bent en proactief meedenkt als het gaat om het verder professionaliseren en efficiënter maken van de bedrijfsprocessen.

Als Financial Controller maak je deel uit van het Finance-team, onder leiding van de CFO. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s binnen het Finance-team, waaronder de Manager Finance & Accounting, de Financial Accountants en uiteraard de CFO. Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie en met collega’s van andere Orange entiteiten.

Samen streven we naar de gebruikelijke Finance-doelen: juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid. Daarbij staan teamgevoel, respect en gelijkwaardigheid, integriteit en betrouwbaarheid, en – niet te vergeten – werkplezier centraal. Met jouw scherpe blik, analytisch vermogen, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel, communicatieve vaardigheden en proactieve houding draag je bij aan het behoud van onze positieve energie binnen het team.

Natuurlijk wil je ook weten hoe het is om bij Orange Cyberdefense te werken. Dit kunnen we het best als volgt omschrijven; informele sfeer, continu in beweging en streven naar verbetering met een krachtig teamgevoel. Er wordt hard gewerkt én hard gelachen! Wij geloven dat wanneer je plezier hebt in je werk, we samen de beste resultaten kunnen bereiken.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

- Een representatief salaris en een bonus van maximaal één maandsalaris.

- 28 vakantiedagen + 2 bedrijfssluitingsdagen.

- Een goede pensioenregeling.

- Mobiliteitsbudget (keuze voor leaseauto).

- Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken.

- Opleidings- en trainingsbudget.

- Jaarlijkse teamactiviteiten en informatiesessies.

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie.

Wat neem je mee?

- Minimaal HBO Finance & Control of vergelijkbaar.

- Minimaal 5 jaar controlling ervaring bij voorkeur binnen de zakelijke dienstverlening.

- Ervaring met ERP‑systemen, bij voorkeur AFAS.

- Bij voorkeur ervaring met Power BI.

- Sterke Excel‑vaardigheden.

- Analytisch, nauwkeurig en leergierig.

- Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

- Beschikbaar voor minimaal 36 uur.

Locatie
Ons kantoor in Utrecht is goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer. Vanaf Utrecht Centraal neem je de busverbinding richting bushalte P+R Papendorp. Vanaf daar is het slechts 5 minuten lopen. Kom je met de auto naar kantoor? Geen probleem, er is parkeergelegenheid.

title: Student ambassador for Orange Cyberdefense!
description:
Are you a university student who wants to pave the way for young professionals in the cybersecurity sector? Do you want to bridge the gap between students and their dream career? If so, we want you to become a Student Ambassador for Orange Cyberdefense!

About the role

Student Ambassadors are a direct link from Orange Cyberdefense to junior talent. You equip fellow young professionals with opportunities and skills to pursue a career in cybersecurity. This is your way of contributing to our vision: to help secure the digital society. By helping junior talent grow, we are making this vision come true.

You will belong to a team of multiple Student Ambassadors from different schools led by a coach. Your main task is to help us develop, plan, and carry out student-oriented events and employer branding activities. You also have the freedom to initiate your own projects and events. The role entails about 10-20 hours of work per month, is unpaid, and is compatible with full-time studies.

Examples of responsibilities include:

- Plan and carry out student-oriented events with other Student Ambassadors, such as student after-works, educational workshops, and on-campus activities.

- Accompany Orange Cyberdefense to security meetups and fairs.

- Create material for cybersecurity workshops and networking events.

- Assist us in developing and marketing educational activities, networking events, and employer branding campaigns.

- Represent Orange Cyberdefense on your university campus and at career fairs.

Who are you?

You must live up to the following requirements:

- You want to contribute to our vision and help junior cybersecurity talent grow.

- You are currently a student at a Swedish university or higher vocational school in Gothenburg, or near Gothenburg.

- You are available for 10-20 hours a month from autumn 2026 through spring 2027, and will continue to be a student during this period.

- You are capable and willing to take initiatives and drive projects forward.

- You share and embody our core values: Simplicity, Humble, Innovation, Respect and Trust.

- You are fluent in both Swedish and English

The following characteristics are desirable, but not mandatory:

- Cybersecurity or a related topic is your main field of study.

- You are interested in marketing, employer branding, and similar fields.

Who are we?

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to help secure the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from advanced technical solutions to strategic services such as security governance, risk management frameworks, and risk assessments. We are 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,000 colleagues globally.

At Orange Cyberdefense, we are all different, but we share the same passion for cybersecurity—and that is our greatest strength. We are proud of our diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, and we firmly believe that creating solutions for everyone requires including everyone. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all applications are assessed fairly and equally.

description:
Purpose of the Role

This role leads channel development and commercialisation for the EMOB business unit and reports directly to the EVP, CyberSecurity Strategy for Emerging Markets, Channel and Orange Business. The role exists to grow and strengthen OB, partner and channel routes to market by combining three capabilities: a strong working knowledge of the cybersecurity services portfolio, seasoned product marketing and channel marketing skills, and sound commercial judgement.

The role owns the development of tailored propositions and go to market frameworks for OB, channel and specialist partners, and translates partner and market needs into structured requirements for the MSS Engine. It designs partner commercial models and pricing structures and owns commercial and financial reporting for the business unit including KPIs, forecasting and performance insight. While the reporting responsibility is significant, the centre of gravity of the role remains channel growth, with reporting serving as the evidence base for channel and proposition decisions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Channel Strategy and Development

• Define and execute the channel development strategy across Emerging Markets, OB and specialist partner routes.

• Align partners aligned to portfolio strengths and regional market priorities.

• Build partner segmentation, coverage plans and growth targets for each route to market.

• Own the partner lifecycle from onboarding through enablement to performance management.

2. Cybersecurity Portfolio Fluency

• Build and maintain a deep working understanding of the full security portfolio including Managed Services, Exposure Management, Posture Management, Threat Intelligence, MDR, OT services and specialist capabilities such as SensePost.

• Analyse the strengths, gaps, differentiators and commercial levers within each service line.

• Translate portfolio understanding into propositions that partners can position, sell and deliver.

3. Product Marketing and Value Propositions

• Create targeted value propositions for OB, channel and specialist partners based on their market position, customer maturity and commercial expectations.

• Define the messaging, outcomes and commercial positioning for each proposition, in plain language that works across regions and non-native English speaking audiences.

• Ensure all propositions support both direct and indirect sales motions.

4. Channel Marketing, Enablement and GTM

• Create or oversee all channel facing content including GTM packs, service descriptions, campaign frameworks and partner training materials.

• Build scalable partner onboarding and enablement programmes that are consistent across regions and partner types.

• Work with regional teams to localise propositions and campaigns for Emerging Markets, US, APAC, MEA, SA, China and Europe.

5. Commercial Structuring for Partners

• Build partner commercial frameworks including pricing, margin models, discount structures and consumption models, working closely with Finance.

• Support the structuring of partner agreements and commercial terms, working with Legal and the Sales and Commercial Support function rather than owning legal drafting.

• Test proposition viability, partner profitability and investment cases using the role's own financial models and reporting.

6. Financial Insight and Commercial Reporting

• Own commercial and financial reporting for the business unit including revenue, margin, pipeline, forecasting and partner performance.

• Lead and build out the KPI framework used in business reviews and executive reporting.

• Build financial models for new services, partner offerings and commercial structures.

• Act as the financial sounding board for the EMOB leadership, supporting investment decisions and performance optimisation.

7. Requirements Intake and Alignment with the MSS Engine

• Help your team gather, structure and prioritise requirements from OB and channel teams.

• Translate these into actionable service development needs for the MSS Engine.

• Ensure portfolio changes and new services align with partner expectations and commercial viability.

8. Cross Functional Coordination

• Maintain close working links with the MSS Engine, Sales, Finance, PS, SMEI, regional teams and the partner ecosystem.

• Work with PS leadership to integrate professional services components into partner propositions where they strengthen the offer.

• Act as the central coordination point for partner and portfolio enablement across EMOB.

Profile and Experience

• Seasoned channel leader with deep experience in cybersecurity services, MSSP operations or technology service portfolios.

• Proven track record as a product marketing and channel marketing professional for service led propositions, not a product management background, including building GTM packs, enablement programmes and partner campaigns.

• Strong understanding of channel ecosystems, indirect sales models and partner economics.

• Strong financial capability including modelling, pricing, profitability, forecasting and business unit reporting, with the confidence to own the numbers in executive reviews.

• Excellent ability to translate technical security services into clear commercial narratives for varied international audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to operate across complex multi stakeholder global organisations.

• Comfortable leading cross functional groups without formal authority.

• Manage a direct team of 3+

Working Relationships

• Reports directly to the EVP, Cybersecurity Strategy for Emerging Markets, Channel and Orange Business, as a member of the EMOB leadership team.

• Owns commercial and financial reporting for the business unit, working in close partnership with Finance and the Service Operating Model function.

• Key interfaces include the MSS Engine, the CRO organisation, regional leaders, PS leadership, Legal, Finance and external partner executives.
